description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily clinical operations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care, and maintaining compliance with all regulatory standards. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader with a strong commitment to resident well-being and staff development.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supervising nursing staff, managing patient care plans, and fostering a positive and efficient work environment. This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to a supportive team dedicated to clinical excellence and continuous improvement. We are looking for a professional who is eager to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents and the success of our nursing department.

This role offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 per year, with compensation based on experience and qualifications. We highly prefer candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) to ensure the highest level of clinical expertise.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, with a salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 per year.
